verdict.rationale: Missive does ship automations: rules (up to 1000), plus AI and MCP-driven workflows. That makes this axis applicable. However, nothing in the evidence shows version history, review or diff of rule changes, or rollback of automation definitions. The general activity log ("every action within Missive is logged") tracks who did what. It does not show versioning or reverting automations, so it cannot be credited for this story.
